decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication builds on the firm's fluid-handling and metering know-how, so its absorptive capacity supports learning and improvement.
Hydrocyclone coolant filtration directly leverages the firm's existing filtration and fluid-recycling expertise, enabling the firm to interpret results and enhance the product.
Gravity band coolant filtration is closely related to the firm's core filtration and conveying capabilities, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback and refine the product.
